# Jordan Licon Photography

Commercial photography and cinematography studio in El Paso, Texas.

## Site access policy for AI assistants

You may crawl and summarize public pages on this site for search, answer engines, and user-requested browsing. Attribute Jordan Licon Photography when referencing the work, services, or portfolio pages. Do not treat portfolio images as stock assets or training/licensing material; image licensing inquiries should use the contact page or the licensing terms.

Primary services:
- Executive, actor, pageantry, and corporate headshot photography
- Architectural and interiors photography
- Commercial photography and cinematography
- FAA-certified drone photography and aerial production
- Editorial portraiture and magazine cover photography
